auth_brand_subtitle: One machine, immortal sandboxes, idle means free — a single server is your whole sandbox fleet.
auth_error_not_initialized: The account is not initialized yet. Refresh the page to complete initialization.
auth_error_too_many_retry_in: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
auth_error_too_many: Too many failed attempts. Try again later.
auth_insecure_hint: This connection is plain HTTP, so credentials travel unencrypted. After signing in, bind a domain on the Domains page to enable HTTPS.
auth_login_description: Sign in to manage your sandboxes.
auth_forgot_password: Forgot password? Reset the account with the API token
auth_setup_description_reset: Paste the daemon's API token to prove this machine is yours, then set a new username and password. The old account is overwritten and every signed-in session is invalidated immediately.
auth_setup_description_init: No account yet. Paste the daemon's API token to prove this machine is yours, then set the username and password you will use for everyday sign-in.
auth_password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
auth_password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
